android_mechanism: Suggested-version query does nested/unindexed scans; fix uses a better index/access path
bug_description: Reading a random classic poem executes 'select * from classicalliterature_classicpoem where id = (select p.id from classicalliterature_classicpoem p order by random() limit 1)', which materializes and sorts every row of the poem table (thousands of rows with long text fields) on each refresh. The classic-poem page runs this query on page entry and on every toolbar refresh tap, so its latency grows linearly with dataset size.
fix_summary: The random pick uses a random id range scan on the primary key (where id >= abs(random()) % max(id) ... order by id limit 1), an O(log n) indexed lookup instead of a full-table sort.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

mechanism_oracle.definition: Wall time of each random-poem SELECT execution (from query start to resultSet ready, visible in database/disk trace activity and hilog), averaged over 10 refreshes.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed query time grows with row count (full scan + sort of N rows); fixed is near-constant. With >= 5000 rows, unfixed_avg_ms > fixed_avg_ms by >= 5x.

reproduction: git -C hosts/jingmo checkout case/jingmo_random_poem_orderby_random/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/jingmo checkout case/jingmo_random_poem_orderby_random/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
